commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. She does not know it but says it is Kothringi. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, and the keystone may matter to that. 2. Go to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in the Kothringi Greathouse; the marker is on Hums-the-Long-Note. 3. I can talk to Hums-the-Long-Note to find the elder, and ask about the keystone. I can see no other choices yet. 4. I do not know who Hums-the-Long-Note is, what the Eye is, or what the keystone does. I can find out by talking to people here.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment: her family grave-stake, in a chest in drowned Zul-Etha. Then she will tell me. 2. Go to Zul-Etha (south-east of Mir-Xal quay), reach the Drowned Chest and raise the stake. 3. Kill the crocodiles and old bull from a roof or with arrows (fight is my build), calm them with Illusion, or swim under unseen. 4. I do not know why she is the one who knows rather than the elder, nor where the elder is. I can ask her later.
take Carved Grave-Stake from Drowned Chest
